Billing
  siren/x1: topic/byte_cost is above 1.073741824e+09
  max(pubsub_googleapis_com:topic_byte_cost{monitored_resource="pubsub_topic",topic_id="x1-incidents"}) > 1.073741824e+09

Dark
  siren/x1: nothing is recording hits
  absent_over_time(custom_googleapis_com:tako_hits{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[21600s])

Erroring
  siren/x1: GET /boom is erroring
  sum(rate(custom_googleapis_com:tako_requests{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1",job="siren",route="GET /boom",status="5xx"}[60s])) / sum(rate(custom_googleapis_com:tako_requests{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1",job="siren",route="GET /boom"}[60s])) > 0.05

Failing
  siren/x1: cron Flaky is failing
  sum(increase(custom_googleapis_com:tako_requests{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1",job="siren",route="/_tako/cron/Flaky",status="5xx"}[3600s])) >= 1

Fat
  siren/x1: container/memory/allocation_time is above 1e+09
  max(run_googleapis_com:container_memory_allocation_time{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision",service_name="x1-siren-grind"}) > 1e+09

Grinding
  siren/x1: work_ms p99 is above 5000
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(custom_googleapis_com:tako_work_ms_bucket{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[60s])) by (le)) > 5000

Idle
  siren/x1: hits count is below 1
  sum(increase(custom_googleapis_com:tako_hits{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[3600s])) < 1

JobBad
  siren/x1: job rebuild is failing
  sum(increase(run_googleapis_com:job_completed_execution_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_job",job_name="x1-siren-rebuilder",result="failed"}[3600s])) >= 1

LoopDown
  siren/x1: singleton Ticker is not running
  max(run_googleapis_com:container_instance_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision",service_name="x1-siren-ticker",state="active"}) < 1

Maxed
  siren/x1: service x1-siren-grind is at its instance ceiling
  max(run_googleapis_com:container_instance_count{monitored_resource="cloud_run_revision",service_name="x1-siren-grind",state="active"}) > 0.5

Missed
  siren/x1: cron Sweep has not run
  absent_over_time(custom_googleapis_com:tako_requests{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1",job="siren",route="/_tako/cron/Sweep"}[600s])

NoThroughput
  siren/x1: work_ms per second is below 0.001
  sum(rate(custom_googleapis_com:tako_work_ms_count{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[60s])) < 0.001

Overworked
  siren/x1: work_ms total is above 600000
  sum(increase(custom_googleapis_com:tako_work_ms_sum{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[600s])) > 600000

Piling
  siren/x1: queue work is backing up
  max(pubsub_googleapis_com:subscription_num_undelivered_messages{monitored_resource="pubsub_subscription",subscription_id="x1-siren-grind"}) >= 50

Poisoned
  siren/x1: queue work is dead-lettering
  max(pubsub_googleapis_com:subscription_num_undelivered_messages{monitored_resource="pubsub_subscription",subscription_id="x1-siren-grind-dead"}) >= 1

Pushback
  siren/x1: subscription/push_request_count is above 10
  max(pubsub_googleapis_com:subscription_push_request_count{monitored_resource="pubsub_subscription",subscription_id="x1-siren-grind",response_class="4xx"}) > 10

Quiet
  siren/x1: hits per second is below 0.01
  sum(rate(custom_googleapis_com:tako_hits{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[60s])) < 0.01

Slowing
  siren/x1: GET /slow is slow
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(custom_googleapis_com:tako_request_ms_bucket{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1",job="siren",route="GET /slow"}[60s])) by (le)) > 2000

Sluggish
  siren/x1: work_ms mean is above 800
  sum(increase(custom_googleapis_com:tako_work_ms_sum{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[60s])) / sum(increase(custom_googleapis_com:tako_work_ms_count{monitored_resource="generic_task",namespace="siren-x1"}[60s])) > 800

Stalling
  siren/x1: queue work is stalling
  max(pubsub_googleapis_com:subscription_oldest_unacked_message_age{monitored_resource="pubsub_subscription",subscription_id="x1-siren-grind"}) > 900

SubPoisoned
  siren/x1: queue incidents is dead-lettering
  max(pubsub_googleapis_com:subscription_num_undelivered_messages{monitored_resource="pubsub_subscription",subscription_id="x1-siren-onalert-dead"}) >= 1

Untriaged
  siren/x1: dead letters of queue work are going untriaged
  max(pubsub_googleapis_com:subscription_oldest_unacked_message_age{monitored_resource="pubsub_subscription",subscription_id="x1-siren-grind-dead"}) > 86400
